{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method takes one parameter, `connection`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `connection` parameter is an instance of the `Connection` class representing the network connection over which the response was received.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method reads the HTTP message and payload from the connection's protocol.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method handles any `HttpProcessingError` exceptions by raising a `ClientResponseError`.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method processes status codes in the 100-199 range, excluding 101, as informational responses.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method waits for a 100-continue response if applicable.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method sets up the response's version, status, reason, headers, payload, and cookies once the final response is received.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method uses the helper method `_response_eof` to handle end-of-file events on the payload.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method uses logging to warn about issues loading cookies.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method returns the `ClientResponse` instance itself after completing its tasks.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `ClientResponse.start` method initiates the processing of an HTTP response received from a server.", "type": "intent"}
]
